subject: Copywriting
title: The Newsletter Renaissance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Newsletter Renaissance.

hook.text: In 2020, Substack turned email newsletters into a $1 billion business.

buildup.text: Social media algorithms hide your content from followers. Email delivers directly. No algorithm, no middleman.

discovery.text: Morning Brew grew to 4 million subscribers and sold for $75 million. A daily email newsletter became a media empire.

twist.text: The newsletter boom made email cool again. The same channel everyone declared dead in 2015 became the hottest in 2021.

climax.text: Email newsletters prove one thing: owned audience beats rented audience.

punchline.text: Email was declared dead. Then newsletters made billions.

quiz.question: How much did Morning Brew sell for?
